title: Why GTA 6 took 13 years (Vex explainer, Scribe; GTA VI launches Nov 19 2026; pen + ink picker)

voice.name: Dolly (Fish library voice, user pick Nov 9)

beats.say: GTA six drops November nineteenth. Thirteen years after GTA five. Here's why it took so long.
Eight years of work, and Rockstar nearly doubled, to forty-seven hundred people.
Real actors play the characters, in suits covered in dots. There's even a team in LA just for the randoms on the street.
Thirteen years for one game. Your stats professor gave you till Friday. Handwritten. Rude.
So Scribe writes it in my handwriting, chart and all. Don't like blue? Switch the pen. Purple fountain pen, and it rewrites the whole page.
Analysts guess it cost over a billion dollars. GTA five? About two hundred sixty-five million.
And it made a billion in three days. See you on the nineteenth.
